clues.text: Sent by the LORD to King David, this prophet told of a rich man who took a poor man's only lamb.
After David said the rich man in a story deserved to die, this prophet told him, "You are that man!"
When David wanted to build a house for the ark of God, this prophet brought word that he was not the one to build it.
Along with Zadok the priest, this prophet anointed Solomon king at Gihon.
When Adonijah set himself up as king, this prophet told Bathsheba to remind David of his oath about Solomon.
The LORD sent word through this prophet that David's newborn son Solomon should be named Jedidiah.
David's psalm begging God for mercy was written when this prophet came to him after his sin with Bathsheba.
